text:
Alex W: Heads up 3 Datadog + OTEL joint roadshow next Tues. want to make the partner demo frictionless (SI + marketplace). Quick sync here.
Priya S: i'm on GTM. we need a short partner-facing demo kit and a technical runbook. who owns the agent trace demo?
Sam (eng): i'll own agent hookup. plan: show traces+metrics for hosted api and private (VPC/onprem) with minimal config.
Jens: for SI customers we should include: architecture slide (OTLP -> proxy -> dd), a troubleshooting checklist, and an onboarding checklist (keys, firewall rules). keep docs concise.
Marcos: i'll draft the one-pager with three variants: k8s daemonset, sidecar, and private-installer snippet. will include sample datadog tags mapping to our trace fields.
Alex W: Priya, can you write the partner bullet points: reliability, cost visibility, traceability (model id/version/prompt id)?
Priya S: yes. i'll add a short blurb about trace enrichment and how to filter by model version in Datadog. need a JSON->tag mapping sample.
Sam (eng): sample OTLP exporter we'll show (for demo cluster):
```yaml
exporters:
  otlp/datadog:
    endpoint: "https://otlp.datadoghq.com:4317"
    headers:
      DD_API_KEY: "<redacted>"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      exporters: [otlp/datadog]
```
Sam (eng): runtime flag for demo: `REDWOOD_TRACE_ENRICH=true` (enables model_id, model_version, prompt_id tags). i'll add it to the script.
Jens: include a slide that explains tag cardinality implications and sampling strategy for heavy workloads. SIs always worry about cardinality and cost.
Marcos: timeline proposal:
- Mon EOD: initial one-pager + snippets (Marcos, Sam)
- Tue AM: dry-run demo (Sam, Jens)
- Tue PM: 5m recorded clip for partner portal (Priya)
- Wed: final deck + SI handoff packet
Priya S: i'll prep the marketplace blurb and the partner email. need the recording link by Tue PM.
Datadog-bot: integration-check: OTLP endpoint reachable from demo cluster - PASS
Alex W: ok meeting at 10:30PT tomorrow to review the dry-run and slide order. calendar invite sent. :calendar:
Marcos: uploading drafts to the shared drive now, will ping when ready. tagging @Sam (eng) and @Priya S :thumbsup:
Sam (eng): small note for runbook: customers behind proxies should set `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_TIMEOUT` to 10s and configure TLS certs. i'll add that.
Jens: and add a short A/B fallback note: if Datadog ingestion is down, we buffer to local file and forward when ready (show config snippet).
Alex W: fantastic. goal: ship the partner kit by Wed so SIs have time to prep before demos.
Priya S: i'll draft the partner-facing FAQ (3 bullets) about data residency, PII handling, and pricing impact.
Sam (eng): putting final snippets and demo script in the drive. will respond here when uploaded.
Marcos: files uploaded: `demo/otlp-snippets.md`, `si-runbook.pdf`, `partner-onepager.md`. link: https://drive.redwood/example (works only internally).
Alex W: thanks all. we'll reconvene in the 10:30 call.
